seo.description: Book a consultation with Woodex Interior — studio at 12 Gulberg Boulevard, Lahore. Residential, commercial and joinery enquiries.

data.title: Let's talk about your space
data.text: Tell us a little about the project and we'll come back within one working day.

data.title: Start a conversation
data.text: Fill in the form, email us, or drop into the studio — we're open Monday to Saturday.
data.consentText: I agree to be contacted about my enquiry.

items.a: A 30-minute introductory call or studio visit is free. On-site consultations are charged and credited against a design fee if you proceed.
